visualCharacteristics.purpose: row of compact link tiles with a centred icon over a bold label
traits: light grey tiles of equal size
centred icon above a bold label
external targets open in a new tab

contentPattern.structure: One row per tile. Cell 1: icon (:icon-name: token or small image). Cell 2: label linked to the target. Cells may be merged or missing: the first icon/image, first link and the text of the row are used

usage: 'Looking for more than just a flight?' style service shortcuts.
reuseGuidance: Use for icon shortcuts. For image + body cards use the vanilla cards block. Icons need SVGs under /icons/ (e.g. hotel.svg, car-rental.svg, airport-parking.svg).
